messages.Praxis · Fizică interactivă este oferită: Praxis · Interactive Physics is provided free of charge by Traian Anghel, a physics teacher at Colegiul Național “Nicolae Iorga” in Brăila, Romania. The app supports learning and teaching physics in Romanian and English, without a mandatory account.
messages.Poți accesa și folosi gratuit laboratoar: You may access and use the laboratories free of charge in class and for individual study. Use the app responsibly, without disrupting the website, attempting unauthorised access to systems or infringing other people’s rights.
messages.Simulările folosesc modele didactice și: The simulations use educational models and simplifying assumptions. Values and graphs support understanding and do not replace professional measurements, a teacher’s assessment or safety rules for real experiments. Check model assumptions and measurement units before interpreting a result.
messages.Accesul gratuit nu transferă drepturile: Free access does not transfer copyright in the app or materials. Author credits and third-party component licences must be respected. For redistribution or use beyond the applicable permissions, request clarification using the contact address. These terms do not restrict uses permitted by law.
messages.Aplicația nu solicită conturi și nu păst: The app does not require accounts and does not retain answers, test results or educational notes between visits. Preferences may be remembered on your device only with your consent. Cookie choices can be changed in the footer. Details about local storage, hosting and contact are provided on the privacy page.
messages.Pot exista întreruperi tehnice, erori sa: Technical interruptions, errors or content changes may occur. We address reported issues and may update the app and these terms. The last update date is shown on this page. A change to the terms does not replace separate consent to remember preferences.
messages.Aceste condiții nu exclud și nu limiteaz: These terms do not exclude or limit rights or liability that cannot be excluded or limited under applicable law. For questions, errors or clarification about use, email contact@praxissciencelab.app.

messages.Aplicația Praxis · Fizică interactivă es: Praxis · Interactive Physics is provided free of charge by Traian Anghel, a physics teacher at Colegiul Național “Nicolae Iorga” in Brăila, Romania.
messages.Biblioteca reunește simulări, explicații: The library brings together physics simulations, explanations, experiments and activities in Romanian and English, for classroom use and individual exploration.
messages.Nu este necesară crearea unui cont. Conț: No account is required. The educational content is free to use, and declining preference storage does not restrict access to the laboratories.
messages.Simulările folosesc modele didactice și: The simulations use educational models and simplifying assumptions. They support understanding and complement classroom explanations and experiments.

messages.Pentru întrebări, sugestii sau semnalare: For questions, suggestions or to report an error, email:
messages.Traian Anghel — profesor de fizică la Co: Traian Anghel — physics teacher at Colegiul Național “Nicolae Iorga”, Brăila, Romania.
messages.Când semnalezi o problemă, menționează l: When reporting a problem, include the laboratory, language and steps to reproduce it. Do not send student names, their results or other unnecessary personal data.
messages.Aplicația nu are formular de contact. Tr: The app has no contact form. The email link opens your email application. If you contact us, your address and message are used to respond to your enquiry; these are not data collected through simulations.
messages.Aplicația nu are conturi de utilizator ș: The app has no user accounts and does not send names, exercise answers, test results or laboratory notes to an application database or server. There is no database of students or results.
messages.Răspunsurile, rezultatele și însemnările: Answers, results and notes remain in page memory or the current working session and are not retained by the app between visits. Files you choose to export or download remain on your device and are managed by you.
messages.În versiunea actuală nu folosim cookies: The current version does not use advertising or analytics cookies and does not load tracking services. Advertising features are inactive.
messages.Cu acordul tău, salvăm doar pe acest dis: With your consent, we save language, sound, colours, text size and display preferences on this device only. These use browser local storage, a technology distinct from cookies, and are not sent to us.
messages.Poți alege „Doar necesare” și poți conti: You can choose “Necessary only” and continue using all laboratories. Preferences will work on the current page without being remembered between visits. Your consent choice is stored locally for 180 days to respect your decision. State needed to return to the library may be stored for the current tab session.
messages.Poți modifica sau retrage acordul oricân: You can change or withdraw consent at any time through “Cookie settings”. If you then choose “Necessary only”, persistent preferences managed by the app are deleted. Local data can also be cleared in your browser settings.
messages.Site-ul este găzduit de Vercel. Livrarea: The website is hosted by Vercel. Delivering and securing pages may involve processing technical data, such as IP addresses and web request information. This technical traffic is separate from answers and educational activity in the simulations.
messages.Unele laboratoare oferă instrumente audi: Some laboratories offer audio tools. The microphone is used only at your request and with browser permission. Recordings and exported files are processed locally; the app does not upload them to an application server.
messages.Pentru întrebări privind această pagină: For questions about this page or data in a contact message, email contact@praxissciencelab.app. Do not include students’ personal data.
